# This is the format the parser exists for: it records priv/ssd under the names
# cold/coldssd, and it has NO shared_ssd and NO TOTAL key at all -- the sampler

# kv_cold_shared_ssd_bytes = 63888556032 B = 59.501 GiB, so the missing key is
# UNRECORDED, not zero: summing what the trace carries gives 8.0 GiB against a
# true 67.5. This file is what holds that reading to account.
